arxiv-2210-11411.title: Holbert: Reading, Writing, Proving and Learning in the Browser HATRA 12
arxiv-2210-11411.creator: Liam O’Connor, Rayhana Amjad
arxiv-2210-11411.description: Abstract . This paper presents Holbert a work-in-progress pedagogical proof assistant and online textbook platform, aimed at the educational use-case, specifically for the teaching of programming language theory. Holbert allows proof exercises and rule definitions to be embedded directly in an online textbook, where proofs and rules can be manipulated using a graphical interface.

arxiv-2210-14100.title: The Capacity of a Finite Field Matrix Channel
arxiv-2210-14100.creator: Simon R. Blackburn, Jessica Claridge
arxiv-2210-14100.description: Abstract The Additive-Multiplicative Matrix Channel (AMMC) was introduced by Silva, Kschischang and Kötter in 2010 to model data transmission using random linear network coding. The input and output of the channel are n × m n\times m matrices over a finite field 𝔽 q \mathbb{F}_{q} .

arxiv-2211-03497.title: Black holes in non-local gravity
arxiv-2211-03497.creator: Luca Buoninfante, Breno L. Giacchini and Tibério de Paula Netto
arxiv-2211-03497.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Luca Buoninfante, Breno L. Giacchini and Tibério de Paula Netto. In this chapter we present a status report of black hole-like solutions in non-local theories of gravity in which the Lagrangians are at least quadratic in curvature and contain specific non-polynomial ( i.e. , non-local) operators. In the absence of exact black hole solutions valid in the whole spacetime, most of the literature on this topic focus on approximate and simplified equations of motion, which could provide insights on the full non-linear solutions.

arxiv-2405-17512.title: On Fairness of Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Models
arxiv-2405-17512.creator: Zhoujie Ding Ken Ziyu Liu Pura Peetathawatchai Berivan Isik Sanmi Koyejo
arxiv-2405-17512.description: Abstract Low-rank adaptation of large models, particularly LoRA, has gained traction due to its computational efficiency. This efficiency, contrasted with the prohibitive costs of full-model fine-tuning, means that practitioners often turn to LoRA without a complete understanding of its ramifications.

arxiv-2406-14301.title: Resource Optimization for Tail-Based Control in Wireless Networked Control Systems
arxiv-2406-14301.creator: Rasika Vijithasena 1 2 , Rafaela Scaciota 1 2 , Mehdi Bennis 1 , , and Sumudu Samarakoon 1 2
arxiv-2406-14301.description: Abstract Achieving control stability is one of the key design challenges of scalable Wireless Networked Control Systems (WNCS) under limited communication and computing resources. This paper explores the use of an alternative control concept defined as tail-based control , which extends the classical Linear Quadratic Regulator (LQR) cost function for multiple dynamic control systems over a shared wireless network.

arxiv-2505-11968.title: Kulkarni limit sets for cyclic quaternionic projective groups
arxiv-2505-11968.creator: Sandipan Dutta, Krishnendu Gongopadhyay and Rahul Mondal
arxiv-2505-11968.description: Abstract . We consider the natural action of the quaternionic projective linear group PSL ⁡ ( n + 1 , ℍ ) \displaystyle\mathrm{PSL}(n+1,\mathbb{H}) on the quaternionic projective space ℙ ℍ n \displaystyle\mathbb{P}^{n}_{\mathbb{H}} . We compute the Kulkarni limit sets for the cyclic subgroups of PSL ⁡ ( n + 1 , ℍ ) \displaystyle\mathrm{PSL}(n+1,\mathbb{H}) .

arxiv-2507-00340.title: Chiral higher-spin symmetry of the celestial twistor sphere
arxiv-2507-00340.creator: Tung Tran
arxiv-2507-00340.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Tung Tran. We study the chiral higher-spin symmetry of the celestial twistor sphere via the chiral higher-spin algebras 𝔠 ​ 𝔞 \mathfrak{ca} associated with certain holomorphic higher-spin theories in twistor space. The chiral higher-spin algebras 𝔠 ​ 𝔞 \mathfrak{ca} are non-unitary W 1 + ∞ ​ [ 𝔤 ] W_{1+\infty}[\mathfrak{g}] algebras in the sense that their higher-spin generators can have negative conformal dimensions. We study 𝔠 ​ 𝔞 \mathfrak{ca} up to first order in quantum correction.

arxiv-2509-04254.title: MuMTAffect: A Multimodal Multitask Affective Framework for Personality and Emotion Recognition from Physiological Signals Conference: ; ; CCS: Computing methodologies Multitask learning CCS: Computing methodologies Multimodal fusion CCS: Human-centered computing Affective computing
arxiv-2509-04254.creator: Meisam Jamshidi Seikavandi, Fabricio Batista Narcizo, Ted Vucurevich, Andrew Burke Dittberner, Paolo Burelli
arxiv-2509-04254.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Meisam Jamshidi Seikavandi, Fabricio Batista Narcizo, Ted Vucurevich, Andrew Burke Dittberner, Paolo Burelli. We present MuMTAffect , a novel Multimodal Multitask Affective Embedding Network designed for joint emotion classification and personality prediction (re-identification) from short physiological signal segments. MuMTAffect integrates multiple physiological modalities pupil dilation , eye gaze , facial action units , and galvanic skin response using dedicated transformer-based encoders for each modality and a fusion transformer to model cross - modal interactions.

A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). WHO

Conflict in the occupied Palestinian territory

The conflict in the occupied Palestinian territory (oPt) intensified with a combination of air strikes and a ground offensive in Gaza launched by the Israeli Defense Force on 27 October. According to the oPt Ministry of Health, as of 10 November at least 11 078 people had been killed since the beginning of hostilities, 41% (4506) of them children. pmc-12593880.title: Suppression of 6-pyruvoyl-tetrahydropterin synthase promotes remyelination in multiple sclerosis
pmc-12593880.creator: Hui Xiao, Ying Long, Yong-shun Guo, Yan-yan Zhu, Yue Wu, Yan-qing Yin, En-wei Ji, Gang Hu, Jun Gao, Jia-wei Zhou
pmc-12593880.description: BackgroundMultiple sclerosis (MS) is a CNS autoimmune disease that is characterized by demyelination, neuroinflammation, and neuronal loss. Although current chemotherapies and immunotherapies for MS efficiently mitigate disease activity and relief clinical symptoms, neuroprotection targeting axon/neurons remains therapeutically challenging. Accumulating evidence has suggested that poor oligodendrocyte precursor cell (OPC) proliferation and subsequent migration/differentiation significantly impedes remyelination during MS.

pmc-13366494.description: Enzymatic C–H hydroxylation of fluorinated amino acids is challenging. The Fe(ii)/2-oxoglutarate oxygenases EcdK and SBQ2 hydroxylate the CF3-adjacent C–H bond of 6,6,6-trifluoro-l-norleucine, with EcdK enabling preparative, (5R)-selective product formation; comparison with 5,5,5-trifluoro-l-norvaline and L92A/F209A/F291A mutagenesis shows that active-site positioning, not bond strength alone, controls reactivity.

pmc-13387514.title: Single-Molecule Fingerprinting of Unlabeled Full-Length Proteins Using an Aerolysin Nanopore
pmc-13387514.creator: Verena Rukes, Evita Norkute, Georges Barnikol, Jingze Duan, Jiajie Gao, Chan Cao
pmc-13387514.description: Proteins play essential roles in cellular processes and are involved in numerous diseases, driving the need for efficient proteoform identification. Recent advances have brought nanopore-based protein fingerprinting within reach, potentially expanding the proteomics toolkit in the near future. Among emerging strategies, label-free, full-length analysis via free translocation is the most promising approach for detecting low-abundance proteoforms.
